Evolution Cycling Sunday Ride

Chicago, IL · Andersonville · Road

Beginner friendly

Evolution Cycling Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Walgreens parking lot, Andersonville. About 45 miles, a group 24+ mph (drop), B group 17–19 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17–19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @evolutioncyclingchicago the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Evolution Cycling Sunday Ride group ride

Two groups up the North Shore. The A group is fast and drops. The B group rides 17–19 mph and welcomes beginners. Coffee after at Hearts & Flour Bakery.
